Architectural hypothesis after CPU/ownership audit: prepare ordered collision packets once per filtered point list, then reject whole packets using conservative interval bounds on the existing perpendicular-distance expression. This targets repeated narrow-phase visits across all six constraint sweeps; it is not another per-line AABB check, velocity-range cache, or direction-only block filter. Original line layout, order, duplicates, state arithmetic, history and physical work remain unchanged. Use one fixed packet width8; no tuning after failure.
First stage untimed shadow: each point-list refresh builds four coefficient ranges (p1x,p1y,normx,normy) for each consecutive group of8 already direction-qualified line pointers. A finite point yields rounded offset ranges [px-max(p1x),px-min(p1x)], likewise y. Multiply interval endpoints in the original component order; all four products enclose every rounded product. Add minima/maxima in original x+y order. If the resulting perpendicular range is wholly <=0 or >=10, every original predicate must fail. Nonfinite geometry or points and any NaN bound return 'cannot exclude'. No reassociation or approximate epsilon. This is a conservative proof by monotonicity of rounded IEEE operations; overflow/NaN fallbacks keep the original path.
Shadow checks every packet at its actual entry position, executes all original lines unchanged (including collisions that move the point), and asserts every predicted rejection produces no event. Count list builds, packet builds, source lines, packet visits, possible excluded line visits, real collision events, and accepted/empty lists. Compare full default track/work/checkpoint. Eligibility for an implementation requires >=70% original narrow-phase line visits excluded and at least4 original line visits excluded per extra packet visit+packet build. These are eligibility diagnostics, not timing evidence. If either fails, close without implementation or packet-size tuning.
If eligible, freeze one candidate with actual packet skips and require fixed default screen12 KEEP and upper95 delta <=-5% to justify new indexing. Fresh24 confirmation sameupper<=-5; broadnative24 upper<=+.5 noREJECT; large8 noREJECT; isolatedstep12, memoryhighwater and all structural/native tests. No screening while builds/checks run.
